statement: Grok Build's pinned extension surface includes plugins, prompt skills, MCP tools, and lifecycle hooks; hook dispatch distinguishes observational events from pre-tool gates that may modify or block an operation.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build 扩展面包括 plugin、prompt skill、MCP tool 与 lifecycle hook；hook dispatch 会区分观察性事件和可修改或阻止操作的 pre-tool gate。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned extension surface includes plugins, prompt skills, MCP tools, and lifecycle hooks, with pre-tool gates able to modify or block operations.

evidence.title: Grok Build hook events
evidence.locator: session, tool, prompt, and subagent hook event types

notes: Extension capability does not imply that third-party extension code is isolated or trustworthy.
